description: Zones wifi gratuit à Antibes Juan-les-Pins is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Antibes. Sites for the establishment of public wifi points in the municipality with indication of the covered area, address and geolocation. Coverage: Ville d'Antibes. The portal shows the English title as "Free wifi zones in Antibes Juan-les-Pins" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Antibes. Its keywords include connectivite, internet-acces, wifi, zone, numerique, internet. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2026-05-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
